title: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Agrees to Testify Before Congress Amid Export Scandal
summary: Following his abrupt resignation from Nvidia, Jensen Huang agreed to testify before Congress over alleged U.S. chip export control lapses and national security concerns. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick will also testify as Nvidia faces sharp market value losses.
popularity_basis: Dominates global tech and mainstream headlines with major geopolitical, regulatory, and market ramifications.

title: Global Microsoft 365 Outage Enters Second Day Before Gradual Recovery
summary: A widespread Microsoft server misconfiguration disrupted Outlook, Teams, and cloud services across 74 countries, impacting hospitals, schools, police, and businesses. Microsoft apologized, ruled out a cyberattack, and restored broad stability after a multi-day outage.
popularity_basis: Broad mainstream coverage across international outlets due to massive global disruption of essential workplace and public-sector communications.

title: Anthropic IPO Reportedly Six Times Oversubscribed Ahead of Nasdaq Debut
summary: Anthropic's upcoming Nasdaq listing under ticker ANT is reportedly six times oversubscribed, putting the AI lab on track to raise up to $90.4 billion including private placements. The offering targets a fully diluted valuation near $1.4 trillion.
popularity_basis: High investor and industry interest in what could become the largest initial public offering in history.

title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Wallet for Biometric-Approved Agent Purchases
summary: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Wallet in limited availability for U.S. Pro users, allowing AI agents to complete checkouts using payment network tokens from Visa, Mastercard, and American Express. Users approve transactions with biometrics without exposing real card numbers.
popularity_basis: Major product expansion into agentic commerce with broad coverage across tech and financial news outlets.

title: FBI and DOJ Disrupt North Korean Deepfake Crypto Scam Worth Over $400 Million
summary: U.S. authorities disrupted FaceStealer, a North Korean cyber campaign that used hijacked accounts and fake video calls to steal over $400 million in cryptocurrency. Officials also secured authorization to seize over $1.2 billion from October's Binance heist.
popularity_basis: Significant law enforcement action against state-sponsored AI-assisted cybercrime and record cryptocurrency thefts.

title: OpenAI Unveils Daybreak Red Team and Defense Factory Security Agents
summary: OpenAI launched Daybreak Red Team for autonomous web application penetration testing and Daybreak Defense Factory to trace vulnerabilities and draft code patches. The tools aim to help security teams validate exploits and prepare human-reviewed fixes faster.
popularity_basis: Strong enterprise and cybersecurity industry interest in automated vulnerability discovery and patching workflows.

title: AI Agent Startup LangChain Raises $300 Million Series C at $3 Billion Valuation
summary: LangChain raised $300 million in Series C funding, more than doubling its valuation to $3 billion. The company is expanding its LangSmith platform to help enterprises build, observe, and govern model-agnostic AI agents in production.
popularity_basis: Major venture funding milestone highlighting sustained investor appetite for AI agent infrastructure startups.

title: Four Nonprofits Sue OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Meta, and SpaceX to Freeze AI Training
summary: Four advocacy nonprofits filed suit in California seeking an emergency injunction to halt frontier AI model training at OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Meta, and SpaceX. Plaintiffs argue the companies must first prove their systems remain under safe human control.
popularity_basis: High-profile legal challenge targeting five leading AI developers simultaneously over frontier model safety.

title: Google Rolls Out Gemini 4 Hydrogen Across Search, Workspace, and Developer APIs
summary: Google made Gemini 4 Hydrogen broadly available across Search, the Gemini app, Sheets, and its developer API at $1.50 per million input tokens. The model replaces Gemini 3.8 Flash with faster agentic execution and a one-million-token context window.
popularity_basis: Flagship model release affecting millions of Search and Workspace users alongside enterprise API pricing.

title: AI Cloud Provider Nscale Reports $1.69 Billion Loss Alongside 1,344% Revenue Surge in IPO Update
summary: London-based AI infrastructure firm Nscale updated its U.S. IPO filing, revealing nine-month revenue jumped 1,344% to $307.5 million while net losses widened to roughly $1.69 billion. The filing underscores the heavy capital costs of scaling AI data centers.
popularity_basis: Closely watched financial disclosure illustrating the unit economics and capital intensity of neocloud infrastructure providers.

title: NTT DATA and IIT Jammu Partner to Launch AI Center of Excellence for Climate Resilience
summary: NTT DATA and the Indian Institute of Technology Jammu established an AI Center of Excellence focused on flood monitoring, landslide early warning, and regional talent development. The initiative targets disaster resilience across Jammu and Kashmir's river basins.
popularity_basis: Notable academic-industry AI infrastructure and talent partnership in India addressing regional climate risk.

title: Intel Showcases Edge and Physical AI Deployments at Web Summit 2026 in Lisbon
summary: Intel demonstrated edge and physical AI systems with ecosystem partners across manufacturing, healthcare, retail, and smart cities at Web Summit 2026. The company highlighted its Open Edge Platform and Altera sensor integration to accelerate real-time industrial robotics.
popularity_basis: Major semiconductor industry showcase demonstrating practical edge AI and industrial robotics adoption.
